skill.name: paid-measurement-loop
skill.description: Guides paid ad readbacks by comparing a campaign change against a control over a fixed window, then returns a Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven decision.
skill.summary: Evaluate paid campaign changes with controlled ROAS and CPA readbacks.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, metadata URLs, and fixed relative documentation links. One real medium-risk issue remains: the skill instructs the agent to run a local ledger command with user-controlled campaign data. A semantic review also found that saved filenames should sanitize campaign names before writing to memory.

remediation.issue: Shell-style ledger command uses user-controlled campaign input.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the shell example with a structured tool call, or require quoting and argument-array execution without shell interpolation.

remediation.issue: Saved readback filename includes a campaign name from user input.
remediation.suggestion: Convert campaign names to safe slugs and reject path separators before writing under memory/ad/paid-measurement-loop/.

remediation.issue: Relative Markdown links resemble traversal patterns to scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that reference links are documentation-only, or use repository-root reference notation where the marketplace supports it.

content.value_statement: Paid ad changes are hard to judge from raw before-and-after numbers. This skill compares each change against a control, normalizes key inputs, and returns a clear decision.
actual_capabilities: Compares paid campaign changes against a control over a fixed readback window.
Returns Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven decisions.
Normalizes attribution windows and currency before cross-platform comparisons.
Flags broken tracking, double-counting, and dirty attribution before promotion.
Delegates ROAS ratio and CPA arithmetic to roi-calculator.
Creates a reusable readback summary when the user chooses to save results.
limitations: It needs user-provided exports or clearly labeled user data.
It does not replace the roi-calculator skill for ROAS or CPA math.
It does not create broad cross-channel performance reports.
It cannot prove a change worked without a valid control and clean tracking.

use_cases.title: Budget Change Readback
use_cases.description: Review a paid campaign budget change after the learning phase and decide whether to promote, keep testing, roll back, or mark unproven.

use_cases.title: Creative Test Decision
use_cases.description: Compare a new creative against an unchanged control and explain whether the observed ROAS or CPA movement is strong enough to act on.

use_cases.title: Cross-Platform ROAS Check
use_cases.description: Normalize attribution windows and currency before comparing paid results from platforms such as Meta and Google.

prompt_templates.title: Read Back a Budget Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner readback with one control campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read back the Campaign X budget increase from [date]. Use Campaign Y as control and decide promote, keep testing, rollback, or unproven.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Creative Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare a new creative against a stable control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the new creative launched on [date]. Compare candidate and control exports, account for conversion lag, and list caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Platform Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when comparing two ad platforms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Meta and Google readbacks using my exports. Normalize attribution windows and currency before explaining which result is stronger.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Measurement Integrity
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before making a paid media decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid change readback. Check tracking, double-counting, attribution mismatch, control quality, and the decision threshold before finalizing a recommendation.

output_examples.input: Read back a budget increase for Campaign X using Campaign Y as the control.
output: The candidate improved ROAS versus baseline, but it did not beat the control by the required margin.
Next step: keep the test active until the next readback date.

output_examples.input: Compare Meta and Google ROAS from exported reports.
output: Verdict: Unproven until normalization is complete.
The exports use different attribution windows and currencies.
Normalize both before choosing a winner.

output_examples.input: Review a creative rotation where conversion tracking may be duplicated.
output: Verdict: Rollback cannot be confirmed yet.
The measurement signal is dirty because the same conversion may be counted twice.
Fix tracking before promoting or reporting the result.

best_practices: Choose the control and readback window before looking at results.
Normalize attribution windows, conversion lag, and currency before comparing platforms.
Label every figure as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Treating a dashboard lift as proof without a control.
Comparing Meta and Google ROAS without attribution normalization.
Promoting a change while conversion tracking is broken or duplicated.

faq.question: What decision does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven for a paid campaign change.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROAS and CPA by itself?
faq.answer: No. It delegates ROAS and CPA arithmetic to roi-calculator and focuses on the measurement decision.

faq.question: What data do I need?
faq.answer: Use campaign exports, conversion data, revenue data, the control definition, attribution window, currency, and change date.

faq.question: Can it compare platforms?
faq.answer: Yes, when attribution windows and currency are normalized before comparison.

faq.question: What happens if there is no control?
faq.answer: The result should be marked Unproven because the readback cannot separate change impact from background movement.

faq.question: Can it save the readback?
faq.answer: Yes, after asking the user. Saved filenames should use sanitized campaign names.
